normalization_plan.reason: The arithmetic operand a only exists as argument of the SafeMath helper and should be folded into the safeAdd core function node.
The arithmetic operand b only exists inside the SafeMath helpers and is normalised into safeAdd.
tokenOwner is only an address key used to read balances and should be merged into balanceOf.
spender is only the allowance key / callback target and is merged into the approve core function.
to is only the credited recipient address and is merged into the transfer core function.
tokens is the amount only consumed by the transfer family and is merged into transfer.
from is only the debited source address in transferFrom and is merged into that function.
_newOwner is only assigned to newOwner by transferOwnership and is merged into it.
tokenAddress is only used as the external call target and is merged into transferAnyERC20Token.
data is only forwarded to the receiveApproval callback and is merged into approveAndCall.
The result variable c exists only inside the SafeMath helpers and is merged into safeAdd.
balance is the return variable of balanceOf and is merged into it.
remaining is the return variable of allowance and is merged into it.
success is the boolean return flag of the transfer family and is merged into transfer.
